notes.title: Beta performance update
notes.notes: Fixed performance drops in certain areas (Stage 1 first catapults, Stage 2 crop fields) noticed when playing on low-end systems or while the system is busy (e.g. screen recording).

notes.title: Development update 10/9
notes.notes:
Some QoL updates for the development version.

[list]
[*]New menu designs are more readable and understandable.
[*]Boss dialogue can be advanced with any of the 3 action buttons/keys, or skipped with the Start button or Esc key.
[*]Option for smooth movement at any screen refresh rate. Found in Screen options menu.
[*]Improved intro cutscene art, courtesy of [url=2dpixx.de]2dpixx.de[/url]
[/list]

notes.title: Development update 9/27
notes.notes: In the development version, the options menu is now accessible from the game pause menu. Also, the Enter key is now hardcoded to activate the selected menu item. If you assigned any game action to Enter, you may want to reassign it.

notes.title: Update plans for 2021
notes.notes:
With most requested features done and major issues fixed, development is going on holiday break. (barring any critical fixes)

Updates will resume in mid or late January, switching to a monthly cycle to allow time for bigger changes (and exploring new game projects).

These are the major features planned for the near future.

[h2]Boss rush stage[/h2]

Fight all bosses one after another. Start with max resources and gain some back with each boss defeated. Don’t let the timer run out. Unlocked by beating the campaign.

[h2]New playable characters[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38218659/dc1adc206b7d949615033e38d6feb44844066eca.gif[/img]

Snow the siren, with sonic attacks that penetrate the enemy’s cover. Unlocked by freeing her from an underwater prison. ([url=https://twitter.com/IoriBranford/status/1309322846787612672]She was started before release[/url] but had to be pushed back.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38218659/eda15b96f6026e81955425386e36b8627345d855.gif[/img]

Fallen Angelina turns her triple arrow against her former brethren. Unlocked by beating the campaign.

[h2]Mission mode[/h2]

Short challenge stages, demanding skillful use of specific game mechanics or combinations of such. Intended as a more fun way to learn advanced mechanics not covered in the basic tutorial.

[h2]Additional polish[/h2]

Character portraits, voice clips, and other touches to help the game feel more alive.

notes.title: Day 3 update
notes.notes:
I realized that basic enemies were tanking a little too much damage, which could make them quite hard and not very rewarding for players to defeat. I lowered their health to more reasonable values.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38218659/df6f7eda8d059463a34f3d5681467d9a23a61649.png[/img] 2 Lv0 bullets / 1 Lv1+ bullet (was 3/2)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38218659/5b703e3c80a3b306873cc8d7227f95909b1656e3.png[/img] 5 Lv0 bullets / 4 Lv1+ bullets (was 8/6)

notes.title: Day 2 patch for demo
notes.notes:
The demo was patched to address some gameplay feedback and issues.
[list]
[*]Reduce bomb warmup a bit.
[*]Reduce Stage 1 boss health a bit.
[*]Increase Stage 2 midboss bullet spread so it's more reasonable to weave through.
[*]Fix some catapult enemies facing the wrong way.
[/list]
